entities.name: Diary of Anne Frank
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The diary kept by Anne Frank (1929-1945), a Jewish girl hiding from Nazi persecution in Amsterdam, from June 12, 1942 to August 1, 1944. Published posthumously in 1947, the diary became the most widely read personal account of the Holocaust, translated into 70+ languages and read by tens of millions, humanizing the suffering of Holocaust victims.
